The '''2021 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages''' were played from 23 February to 15 April 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/fechas-actualizadas-de-las-competiciones-de-clubes-2021|title=Fechas actualizadas de las competiciones de clubes 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=4 February 2021|language=es}}</ref> A total of 19 teams competed in the qualifying stages to decide four of the 32 places in the [[2021 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]] of the [[2021 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/manual-de-clubes-cl-2021.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

The qualifying stages had been originally scheduled to be played from 16 February to 8 April 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2021_02_10_2020.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2021: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref>
 
==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the qualifying stages was held on 5 February 2021, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Qualifying stages draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/este-viernes-se-sortea-el-camino-para-las-competiciones-de-clubes-2021|title=Este viernes se sortea el camino para las competiciones de clubes 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=2 February 2021|language=es}}</ref><ref name="fixture 1S-2S">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/la-suerte-esta-echada-en-la-conmebol-libertadores|title=La suerte está echada en la CONMEBOL Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 February 2021|language=es}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 1 February 2021 (shown in parentheses),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/se-lanza-el-ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2021|title=Se lanza el Ranking de Clubes CONMEBOL 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es}}</ref><ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/conmebol_-_rankings_2021_-_1_febrero_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2011–2020.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2010 and 2002-2010 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years

For the second stage, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (C1–C8), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie, excluding the three winners of the first stage, which were seeded in Pot 2 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same tie with another team from the same association.

For the third stage, the eight winners of the second stage were allocated without any draw into the following four ties (G1–G4), with the team in each tie with the higher CONMEBOL ranking hosting the second leg. As their identity was not known at the time of the draw, they could be drawn into the same tie with another team from the same association.

*Second stage winner C1 vs. Second stage winner C8
*Second stage winner C2 vs. Second stage winner C7
*Second stage winner C3 vs. Second stage winner C6
*Second stage winner C4 vs. Second stage winner C5<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the qualifying stages, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] will be used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Format />

==Bracket==
<section begin=Bracket />
The qualifying stages are structured as follows:
*'''First stage (6 teams):''' The three winners of the first stage advance to the second stage to join the 13 teams which are given byes to the second stage.
*'''Second stage (16 teams):''' The eight winners of the second stage advance to the third stage.
*'''Third stage (8 teams):''' The four winners of the third stage advance to the [[2021 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]] to join the 28 direct entrants. The four teams eliminated in the third stage enter the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana group stage|Copa Sudamericana group stage]].<section end=Bracket />
The bracket was decided based on the first stage draw and second stage draw, which was held on 5 February 2021.
